title: Coil Cleaning, Lamp Replacement, Ionisation and Duct Cleaning Rule under the Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs
content:
Field service rule for coil and purification work under the Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs.

Coil cleaning is performed at the tier's number of visits per year, with coil coating and drain pan treatment carried out at the visits of the tiers that include them. Ultraviolet lamps are replaced at the tier's replacement interval counted in whole calendar months from the day the lamp was last fitted, and lamps beyond the tier's included count are charged at the tier's lamp price. Bipolar ionisation equipment is serviced only at the tiers that cover it, and at every other tier such equipment is quoted as demand work. Duct cleaning is included only at the top tier; elsewhere it is quoted with the tier's duct cleaning discount applied. Where mould is found, the company reports it and, at the tiers that include the referral, arranges a licensed remediation contractor, but it never performs remediation itself.

### Each line of the rule, by kind of work

| Kind of work | What the tier decides | Treatment |
|---|---|---|
| Coil cleaning | The number of visits per year | Performed at that number of visits |
| Coil coating | Whether the tier includes it | Carried out at the coil visits of the tiers that include it |
| Drain pan treatment | Whether the tier includes it | Carried out at the visits of the tiers that include it |
| Ultraviolet lamp replacement | The included lamp count, the replacement interval, the lamp price | Replaced at the interval; lamps beyond the included count charged at the lamp price |
| Bipolar ionisation service | Whether the tier covers it | Serviced under the program where covered; quoted as demand work at every other tier |
| Duct cleaning | Whether included; otherwise the discount | Included at the top tier only; elsewhere quoted with the tier's discount applied |
| Mould found | Whether the tier includes the referral | Reported at every tier; a licensed remediation contractor is arranged at the tiers that include the referral; remediation is never performed by the company |

### Lamp replacement interval, in months

The interval is counted in whole calendar months from the day the lamp was last fitted. On hypothetical inputs, a lamp fitted on 2026-02-10 at a tier with a 12-month interval falls due for replacement on 2026-02-10 twelve whole months later, that is on 2027-02-10; at a tier with a 9-month interval the same lamp falls due on 2026-11-10. A lamp count in excess of the tier's included lamps is charged at the tier's lamp price for each lamp beyond that count: a hypothetical unit carrying 3 lamps under a tier that includes 2 per unit has 1 lamp beyond the count, charged at the tier's lamp price.

### Duct cleaning quoted with the discount

Where the tier does not include duct cleaning, the amount payable is the quoted duct cleaning price less the tier's discount percentage of that quoted price. On a hypothetical quote of 2,000 USD at a tier with a 10 percent discount, the discount is 200 USD and the amount payable is 1,800 USD; at a tier with a 15 percent discount the discount is 300 USD and the amount payable is 1,700 USD.
